name.description: Role name (role name, identifiers.adoc); equals the file name without .json.

tools.description: The exact tool set: PM-MCP tools and harness tools by their per-harness names, within the set of the class; never a pattern. Empty for zero_tool.

harness.description: harness_id of the harness's harness profile.

model.description: Model identifier as the harness takes it.

effort.description: Effort value as the harness takes it; null: no effort flag.

count.description: Workers of the role that run at once per project.

skills.description: The role's skills in delivery order (document grammar: identifiers registry, Skill URI), compiled skills or extension skills (skill://pm/ext/<name>/SKILL.md); the first is the role skill, the role's contract.

recycling.description: Required for form warm, absent for form fresh.

budget_floor_seconds.description: Floor of the job budget learned for the role.

context_budget_tokens.description: Context budget of a worker of the role, the basis of the per-envelope packing budget; absent: the harness fallback of the harness profile.

hold_seconds.description: How long a worker of the role holds its task for the answer to its question; 0: no hold. Cut to the harness's max_hold_seconds.

resume_within_seconds.description: How long a task of the role stays suspended for a resume after the hold; 0: no resume. Cut to the harness's resume.max_age_seconds.

questions.description: Continuation after a question (Continuing after a Question); absent: a task of the role that asks ends asked. Not allowed for zero_tool.

off_track.description: Thresholds and actions of the off-track signals of the role's workers (A Worker Off Track); a signal absent here takes its compiled threshold and the action show. Not allowed for zero_tool.

threshold.description: Lowers the compiled threshold of the signal, never raises it; absent: the compiled threshold.
